# The notebooks {.unnumbered}

Every measurement in the book comes from one of these notebooks. Each is shown with the outputs of
the run that produced it, against the lab's containers on one laptop. The book build does not run
them again; to run one yourself, see [Running the lab](../chapters/running-the-lab.qmd).

| notebook | chapter | server |
|---|---|---|
| [Sync vs async](sync_vs_async.ipynb) | [Sync and async](../chapters/sqlalchemy.qmd) | pg16 |
| [JSONB playground](jsonb_playground.ipynb) | [Documents](../chapters/jsonb.qmd) | pg16 |
| [PgBouncer measured](pgbouncer_playground.ipynb) | [PgBouncer](../chapters/pgbouncer.qmd) | pg16 + PgBouncer |
| [PGlite playground](pglite_playground.ipynb) | [Postgres without a server](../chapters/pglite.qmd) | none |
| [pgvector playground](pgvector_playground.ipynb) | [Vectors](../chapters/pgvector.qmd), [Indexes](../chapters/vector-indexes.qmd) | pg18 |
| [pgqueuer taken apart](pgqueuer_playground.ipynb) | [A job queue](../chapters/pgqueuer.qmd) | pg16 |
| [pgmq playground](pgmq_playground.ipynb) | [A message queue](../chapters/pgmq.qmd) | pg18 |
| [Logical replication](logical_replication.ipynb) | [CDC](../chapters/logical-replication.qmd) | pg16 + replica |
| [Doris CDC](doris_cdc.ipynb) | [Doris](../chapters/doris.qmd) | pg16 + Doris |
| [pg_ducklake playground](pg_ducklake_playground.ipynb) | [A lakehouse table](../chapters/ducklake.qmd) | ducklake |
